title: oenothera parryi f. tenuissima
intro: Oenothera parryi f. tenuissima, commonly known as Camisana or Evening Primrose, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is a natural source of gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), an essential fatty acid with various health benefits. The health benefits of Oenothera parryi f. tenuissima include reducing inflammation, improving skin health, and alleviating symptoms of premenstrual syndrome. The plant's bioactive constituents include GLA, which is believed to exert therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
